Tess (People Ops): Quick update: we're publishing a compact handbook clarification to the Leaves & Time section that explicitly separates "bereavement" and "compassionate" leave, adds three short, scenario-based examples, and links the accommodations request form. We're requiring a 15-min manager microtraining + a short 5-question quiz. Companywide ack of the diff required by EOM. Announcement goes live in ~30m. Links: https://tiny.redwood/leave-clarify | ack: https://tiny.redwood/ack

Rohan (People Ops): Are managers the only mandatory group? what's the pass threshold and remediation flow?

Tess (People Ops): Managers: mandatory training + quiz. Pass threshold = 80%. Non-completion after reminders -> escalation to HRBP. Fail twice -> coaching convo with HRBP. Individual contributors: please read and ack; microtraining optional.

Mei (HRBP): I'll coordinate regional callouts for statutory differences (EU/UK/APAC) and add a short note for country annexes. Also building a manager roster export for tracking.

Alex (Eng Manager): Will there be live Q&A times that accommodate APAC late afternoons? we prefer >2 time zone windows. Also can we get results delivered to our LMS?

people-ops-bot: Training created: "Leaves - Bereavement vs Compassionate (2026-Q4)" Training ID: leaves-2026-q4. Quiz ID: qz-leaves-2026-q4. Results webhook: https://api.redwood.internal/training/results/leaves-2026-q4. Calendar sessions: 2026-11-02T14:00Z (EMEA friendly), 2026-11-03T02:00Z (APAC friendly). Recording will be posted.

Rohan (People Ops): CSV export fields planned: manager_email,org_path,team_count,quiz_status,quiz_score,training_viewed,ack_status,ack_timestamp,region,accommodation_request. We'll push weekly CSVs and an hourly webhook for near-real-time updates.

Clare (Legal): Reviewed copy. This is clarificatory guidance, not a change to contractual terms. If any employment agreement or collective bargaining arrangement explicitly references bereavement terms, route questions to me before sending individualized ack requests. Also add a privacy notice in the ack flow regarding medical details.

Mei (HRBP): I'll add an "exceptions" column to the CSV for legal flags and a free-text notes column for accommodations. Also coordinating with regional leads to validate examples.

Alex (Eng Manager): Can the CSV be SFTP'd and also sent as a Slack DM to managers with completion status? that helps us nudge.

people-ops-bot: Weekly export scheduled: sftp://hr-exports.redwood/handbook/leave-update/ (Fri 06:00 UTC). Webhook: https://hooks.redwood.internal/peopleops/leave-status

Rohan (People Ops): Action list: Tess publish announcement + pinned links (owner); Mei regional callout + HR lead review (owner); Rohan enable exports/webhooks + LMS webhook (owner); Clare spot-check contract edge cases (owner). Reminders: day 4 and day 8; final cutoff EOM. :spiral_calendar:

Alex (Eng Manager): noted, will pass roster + nudge managers. thanks.

Tess (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll upload the final manager email template and the recording link after the first drop-in. Ping Clare/Mei for any contract or accommodation edge cases. :white_check_mark:
